description: Bike Share Figures 2025 2028 FCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Fingal County Council. This data set contains the details of Bike Rental Scheme within Fingal County Council from 2025-2028 inclusive. See older data set Bike Shares 2022-2024FCC. You don’t need to own a bike to get cycling you can sign up for Bleeper or Tier and unlock a bike or e bike to use whenever you need one. Coverage: Fingal County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Fingal County Council. Its tags are Accessibility, Active, Active Travel, Age Friendly, Bike. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
